snippet.title: The Spell Brigade - Official Early Access Update 13 Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the latest The Spell Brigade trailer for this online co-op Survivors-like game for 1-4 players, and see what to expect with the new Early Access update. In The Spell Brigade, team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet hell! Early Access Update 13 of The Spell Brigade is out now on PC.
